name: MRP 变更请求与 SAP Business Network 集成 (65D)
name_en: MRP Change Request Integration with SAP Business Network (65D)
description_en_html:
Overview

In times of changing customer demands, the material planner must react regularly to changes suggested by the MRP situation (for example, already ordered purchase orders should be updated by changing the requested date or quantity). Because of the high number of orders per day addressed to many different suppliers, an automated solution is provided to negotiate the changes with the suppliers.

With the Create MRP Change Requests app, you can work on rescheduling proposals coming from MRP, create MRP change requests, and transfer these change requests from an SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system to the SAP Business Network for Supply Chain, which connects suppliers with the buying organization. The supplier can decide about an answer to the request (accept, reject, or new proposal), and can send the change request answer back to the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system. The requests can finally be either applied or discarded. The supplier is also informed about the decision. If the requests are applied, the corresponding purchase order is automatically changed.

Key Process Flow

  • Schedule job to create proposals from MRP rescheduling checks
  • Create MRP change requests
  • Send MRP change requests to the SAP Business Network for Supply Chain
  • Handle MRP change requests in the SAP Business Network for Supply Chain
  • Send back answers to the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system
  • Receive answers to MRP change requests
  • Apply or discard MRP change requests
  • Send final confirmation to the SAP Business Network for Supply Chain

Business Benefits

  • Use an automated solution with APIs to replace interaction with suppliers by mail or phone
  • Send rescheduling information from the MRP directly to suppliers
  • Track status for change requests
  • View additional information, such as priority, reasons, or comments available
description_zh_html:
概览

在客户需求发生变化时，物料计划员必须定期对 MRP 情况建议的更改做出反应（例如，应通过更改请求的日期或数量来更新已订购的采购订单）。由于每天有大量订单发送给许多不同的供应商，因此提供了自动化解决方案以与供应商协商更改。

使用创建 MRP 变更请求应用，您可以重新计划来自 MRP 的建议，创建 MRP 变更请求，并将这些变更请求从 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统传输到连接供应商与采购组织的 SAP Business Network for Supply Chain。供应商可以决定对请求的回答（接受、拒绝或新建议），并将更改请求答案发送回 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统。最终可以应用或放弃请求。还会向供应商通知有关决策的信息。如果应用了请求，则会自动更改相应的采购订单。

关键流程流

  • 计划作业以通过 MRP 重新计划检查创建建议
  • 创建 MRP 变更请求
  • 将 MRP 变更请求发送到 SAP Business Network for Supply Chain
  • 在 SAP Business Network for Supply Chain 中处理 MRP 变更请求
  • 将答案发送回 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统
  • 接收 MRP 变更请求的答案
  • 应用或放弃 MRP 变更请求
  • 向 SAP Business Network for Supply Chain 发送最终确认

业务优势

  • 将自动化解决方案与 API 结合使用，以替换通过邮件或电话与供应商进行的交互
  • 将重新计划信息从 MRP 直接发送给供应商
  • 跟踪变更请求的状态
  • 查看附加信息，例如优先级、原因或可用注释
